title: OpenSoha credential-bearing connector action v1
description: Only over authenticated HTTPS or loopback transport, after an action explicitly declares credentialProtocol and aliases. Core pins and authorizes references. Credentials are invocation-local; never persist them in logs, queues, events or results. Actions without credentials keep the unversioned envelope. Runtime additionally rejects a canonical UTF-8 JSON envelope exceeding 1 MiB before dispatch. Cancellation signals and response rejection are cooperative, not proof that an external side effect stopped; action implementations must honor the signal and reconcile effects. All string material including structured keys is confidential.

expiresAt.description: Reject expired or more than two minutes in the future; signal cancellation and reject late responses when reached or caller disconnects. The connector must cooperate; this does not prove external effects stopped.

value.description: Runtime additionally enforces a 64 KiB UTF-8 byte limit; structured material is bounded to depth 16 and 64 distinct nonempty strings including keys and the opaque value for redaction.

credentialProtocol.description: Opt-in support for per-call delivery, not a requirement for every action call. Without credentials the existing envelope remains valid; actions requiring authentication must reject missing credentials themselves.
